title: F97 a skill usable in the chat that made it: the three children

cards.title: A skill the agent makes, used at once
cards.text: The chat that makes a skill uses it straight away, every chat after has it once approved, and the chat never breaks.

cards.title: F97.1 One skill shape
cards.text: Tools and skills become one kind: a folder, typed parameters, a script reading JSON on stdin, one loader, every path in one place.

cards.title: F97.2 Draft, door, approve
cards.text: A draft the chat uses through one door, /approve and /reject on folders, and a note so the model knows.

cards.title: F97.3 Claude calls it by name
cards.text: A paid proof first; if it holds, Claude calls a new skill by its own name in the chat that made it.
